te: Vercingetorix, leader of the Gauls, surrenders to the Romans under Julius Caesar, ending the siege and battle of Alesia.
dz: 高卢战争:高卢人领袖Vercingetorix在尤利乌斯·凯撒下向罗马人投降,结束了对阿莱西亚的围攻和战事.
de: Gallic Wars: Vercingetorix, leader of the Gauls, surrenders to the Romans under Julius Caesar, ending the siege and battle of Alesia.
